title: Read existing Pi auth, MCP, and session configuration without changing it

requires.credentials: Use only already configured QA provider metadata; never save or paste a credential in this case
requires.mcp: The workspace may contain an existing read-only MCP configuration; this probe does not create or mutate one

successSignals: Only GET requests are issued for credentials, workspace MCP configuration, and session listing
All three read requests return 200 without exposing response bodies in artifacts
